description: Porto-Saragozza Solidale is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. Associazioni e Parrocchie del territorio, insieme con il Quartiere Porto-Saragozza e i Servizi Sociali, in una rete di solidarietà per offrire un aiuto a chi ha più bisogno. Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Popolazione e società. Its keywords are Bologna solidale. The portal shows 9 records. The portal shows 2020-07-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
